posts.hook: an AI lab says it just cracked a famous computer science assumption
posts.caption: openai claims a proof that the exponential time hypothesis is false, cloudflare discloses a model leaked other customers' prompts, broadcom lines up $63b to fund anthropic's chips. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)
